CEO-Kim: Exec weekly update  Quick summary: we are targeting EU Private GA next Friday. Major blockers: burst capacity policy, reduced eval retention, and the SRE rollback thresholds. Need signoffs to stay on schedule.

CEO-Kim: Key numbers: p95 latency 230ms (+20ms), token cost +9% QoQ (rerank-heavy), incident rate steady at 0.5%.

CEO-Kim: Action items (owners):
- Ravi/VP-Eng-Nate: approve temporary burst-cap (24-48h) to handle ramp.
- Head-Security-Ava + Legal: sign off on Optimize eval retention change: 90d -> 60d, scrubbed access only.
- Head-SRE-Lin: confirm canary cadence and automated fallback thresholds.

VP-Eng-Nate: We propose preemptible burst nodes + priority routing. Cost estimate: short-term +15% if sustained; will add sensitivity table.

Head-Security-Ava: Need assurance no raw customer payloads in evals and auditable deletion. I'll review and sign if scrubbed.

Head-SRE-Lin: Proposed canary: 1% traffic for 2h, expand to 5% then 20% over 6h if healthy. Fallback triggers: error-rate >1.0% for 10m OR p95 >360ms for 15m -> shift 30% to hosted. I'll add runbook entry.

deploy-bot: Release scheduled: eu-private/ga-candidate -> canary @ 1771180800. CI: smoke tests passed.

CFO-Rahul: Finance wants a commit vs burst cost matrix by Wed EOD. Will need assumptions on duration and percent traffic.

CEO-Kim: If any owner expects not to signoff, flag by Tue 18:00 UTC. We will run a 20m sync Wed 16:00 UTC to confirm. Plan is to GA safely, not fast. :white_check_mark:

VP-Eng-Nate: Ack, will post cost sheet and burst config.

Head-SRE-Lin: Ack, will update dashboards and alerting.

Head-Security-Ava: Ack, starting review.

CFO-Rahul: Ack, will model sensitivity.

CEO-Kim: Thanks all. I'll send final note after Wed sync.
